title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Atelier and Size-Change Settings by Reservation Type
content:
The Made-to-Order atelier and the reservations team keep these settings for every Pre-Orders & Back-Orders type. They cover production time, personalisation, whether the customer must confirm specifications themselves and by when, and whether a size can be changed before allocation.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Production lead time, calendar days from production start to completion | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 42 |
| Monogramming or custom specifications taken | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Production waits for the customer's own confirmation of sizes and personalisation | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Specifications to be confirmed within, calendar days after the reservation date | 0 (not required) | 0 (not required) | 0 (not required) | 0 (not required) | 0 (not required) | 7 |
| Confirmed specifications can be changed | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Size of an unallocated reservation can be changed | No | No | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Most size changes per reservation | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 |

**What the figures mean**

- A lead time of 0 marks a type that is not made to order. Only the Made-to-Order Reservation is built, over 42 calendar days from the start of production.
- Personalisation and the customer's own confirmation of specifications go together: both apply to the Made-to-Order Reservation alone, whose confirmation window is 7 calendar days.
- Once confirmed, specifications are fixed for every type.
- A size change is available only on the Seasonal Pre-Order and the Deposit Pre-Order, at most once per reservation. Every other type shows 0 changes.
